Actually, I'd like to go think about it for a while.
Marvelous.
I'll be here when you figure it out.
Whatta grouch.
Later that day^
Now THAT was interesting!
Yeah^\255\003Say, can I see that kite for a second?
column2: 是啊^\255\003欸，那風箏能不能借我看一下？

column1: No!  I'm taking it back to my lab in Philly right now, so I can study the results!
column2: 不行！我現在就要把它帶回費城的實驗室研究結果！

column1: Wish me luck.
I never got your name!
It's Hoagie, sir.
Nice working with you, Hoagie.\255\003I promise to name an invention after you someday.
column2: 跟你合作很愉快，霍基。\255\003我保證哪天發明個東西以你命名。

column1: Gosh, thanks.
So what happened after I fainted?
column2: 那我昏過去之後怎麼了？

column1: Well, after the lightning hit the kite, it came crashing down on your head.
column2: 呃，閃電打中風箏之後，它就砸到你頭上了。

column1: The lightning?
No, the kite.
Same strange phenomenon?
Yes.
Drat!
What do you think we should do?
Try, try again!
I'd like to go back to my lab and consider the situation.
column2: 我想回實驗室好好考慮一下狀況。

column1: That's the spirit!
Sounds like something I would say!
column2: 這話聽起來像我會說的！

column1: Ready for another brush with destiny?
column2: 準備好再跟命運擦身而過一次了嗎？

column1: Sure, why not?
I'd rather mope around some more.
Splendid.
I'll be waiting.
I got something good for ya, Mister^\255\003^uh, Mister^
column2: 我有個好東西要給你，那個^\255\003^呃，那個^

column1: Mr. Brainstorm?\255\003Yes, hand it over.
Hmmm^\255\003Doesn't this belong to somebody?
column2: 嗯^\255\003這不是別人的東西嗎？

column1: Yeah, Red Edison.
Ah.
I'm sorry, but the man has no vision!\255\003A lightweight, durable fabric like this, going to waste down in his basement^
column2: 抱歉，但那個人毫無遠見！\255\003這麼輕又耐用的布料，就這樣爛在他地下室裡^

column1: When I'm done with it, it will fly!
column2: 等我弄好，它可是會飛的！

column1: Hmmm^
Eureka!
The All-Season Frank-O-Copter!\255\003Ready to make history!
column2: 全季節法蘭克直升機！\255\003準備寫下歷史！

column1: No, there's no fuse.
So what do I light?
For the last time, you're not going to light anything!
column2: 最後說一次，你什麼都不用點！

column1: You just push it!
The whole time?\255\003How am I going to get up that high?
column2: 一直推？\255\003我要怎麼爬那麼高？

column1: Listen, just wait for me to say the word, `Now`^\255\003^then push the kite into the air.\255\003All right?
column2: 聽好，你只要等我喊 `現在`^\255\003^然後把風箏推上天。\255\003可以嗎？

column1: I'm on ya, lasagna.
Let's hope so.
Hi there, Mister^
Franklin!\255\003Ben Franklin!\255\003Soon to be known as The Inventor of Electricity!
column2: 富蘭克林！\255\003班・富蘭克林！\255\003即將以「電的發明者」聞名於世！

column1: Um, do you know Red Edison?\255\003He's a scientist guy too.
column2: 呃，你認識瑞德・艾迪生嗎？\255\003他也是搞科學的。

column1: Red Edison?  A SCIENTIST?
He's just an innkeeper who PRETENDS to be a scientist!\255\003And he's not very good at doing either one!
column2: 他只是個假裝自己是科學家的客棧老闆！\255\003而且這兩件事他都做不好！

column1: I can't believe Washington and Jefferson picked HIS inn, of all places, to write our constitution^
column2: 我真不敢相信華盛頓和傑佛遜偏偏挑他的客棧來寫我們的憲法^

column1: Excuse me, Mister^
Mr. Electricity?
Mr. Power?
Mr. Lightning Tamer?
Mighty Electric Man?
Big Thunder Ben?
He Who Glows with Righteousness?
Mr. Hammer of the Gods?
Hey, I read that book.
Mr. Most Powerful Man on Earth?
Mr. Mundane-No-More?
Mr. It-Strikes-Twice-If-I-Say-It-Does?
column2: 我說劈兩次就劈兩次先生？

column1: That would be me.
Shouldn't you say, `The DISCOVERER of Electricity?`
column2: 你不是應該說 `電的發現者` 嗎？

column1: I need Red to help me save humanity.
column2: 我需要瑞德幫我拯救人類。

column1: Whatcha doin' there?
Do you mean Washington, like, PRESIDENT Washington?
column2: 你是說華盛頓？那個總統華盛頓？

column1: Speaking of mad science^
Um, what was that part just before the crazy laugh?
column2: 呃，你在瘋狂大笑之前講的那段是什麼？

column1: So where's this Red guy at?
What's so bad about Red?
Aren't you the hundred-dollar guy?
column2: 你不是那個百元鈔上的人嗎？

column1: Yeah, I can't believe it either.  Well, see ya^
column2: 對啊，我也不敢相信。好啦，再見^

column1: Well, see ya^
Hmmm^\255\003`The Hundred Dollar Guy^`\255\003^not bad.
You think the ultimate power in the universe is just under some rock, waiting to be discovered?
column2: 你以為宇宙間的終極力量就躺在某塊石頭底下，等人去發現？

column1: Ha!
I, Ben Franklin, am going to SUMMON power from the sky by sheer force of GENIUS!
column2: 我，班・富蘭克林，將以純粹的天才之力，從天上召喚力量！

column1: So he's a missionary now, eh?\255\003Well, why not?\255\003Can't be any worse at that than he is at inventing!
column2: 所以他現在是傳教士了？\255\003也罷，有何不可？\255\003再怎麼樣也不會比他發明東西更糟！

column1: Down in his secret lab, of course, neglecting his guests.
column2: 當然是在他的秘密實驗室裡，把客人晾在一邊。

column1: Did he tell you he was president?\255\003The nerve of that guy!  Always trying to run things^
column2: 他跟你說他是總統嗎？\255\003那傢伙真敢講！老想著管東管西^

column1: But of course, no one will care who's president once I've harnessed the ultimate power:\255\003The power of ELECTRICITY!!!
column2: 不過當然啦，等我駕馭了終極力量，沒人會在乎誰是總統：\255\003那就是電的力量！！！

column1: Bwah-ha ha!
What can you say about a guy who spent the last four years perfecting a left-handed hammer?\255\003He's insane!
column2: 一個花了四年在完善左撇子鐵鎚的人，你還能說什麼？\255\003他瘋了！

column1: And he steals other people's inventions too^\255\003^before they can even apply for the patent.
column2: 而且他還偷別人的發明^\255\003^在人家還來不及申請專利之前。

column1: Not that I'm bitter^
Carry on!
And a great day it is for it, too!
column2: 而且今天正是個好日子！

column1: My experiments are bringing me ever closer to complete mastery over nature!
column2: 我的實驗讓我離完全掌控自然愈來愈近了！

column1: As we speak, I am attempting to lure power out of the Heavens to do my bidding^
column2: 就在此刻，我正試圖把力量從天上引下來聽我使喚^

column1: When I succeed, I truly shall be the most powerful man on Earth!
column2: 等我成功，我將真正成為地表最強之人！

column1: You are truly whacked, Ben.
I wonder what Red would say about that.
I could use a little power myself, for my time machine.
column2: 我自己也需要一點電，給我的時光機用。

column1: How exactly are you going to do that power-luring?
column2: 你到底要怎麼把力量引下來？

column1: I have a question about that power-luring thing.
column2: 關於引力量那件事，我有個問題。

column1: When you're all-powerful, will you need a number-two guy?
column2: 等你無所不能了，需要個二把手嗎？

column1: Well, I'll let you get back to your tugging.
Who cares about that crackpot?
Ha!  That's what they said about the man who invented bifocals.
column2: 哈！當年他們也是這樣說那個發明雙光眼鏡的人。

column1: Wasn't that you?
Good point!\255\003Guess they were right!
column2: 說得好！\255\003看來他們沒說錯！

column1: I'll have millions grovelling at my feet, begging to serve me.
column2: 到時會有千萬人匍匐在我腳下，求著為我效勞。

column1: Will you need anyone to set up lights?
Will you need anyone to do sound checks?
column2: 你需要人做音響測試嗎？

column1: Will you need anyone to pack up drums?
Will you need anyone to tape down mike cords?
column2: 你需要人把麥克風線貼好嗎？

column1: Will you need anyone to strike sets?
Will you need anyone to let chicks backstage?
column2: 你需要人放妹子進後台嗎？

column1: Will you need anyone to roll you over when you pass out?
column2: 你需要人在你昏倒時幫你翻身嗎？

column1: Will you need anyone to help with the kite?
column2: 你需要人幫忙弄風箏嗎？

column1: I won't need lights because my body will be glowing so brightly with the power of the heavens.
column2: 我不需要燈光，因為我的身體會因天上的力量而發出耀眼光芒。

column1: I don't need to be checked.\255\003As you can see, I'm perfectly sound.
column2: 我不需要什麼音響測試。\255\003你看得出來，我這人響噹噹的。

column1: Who needs drums when I have the roll of thunder at my command?
column2: 我能號令雷聲滾滾，還要鼓做什麼？

column1: Who is Mike Cords and why does he need to be taped down?
column2: 麥克・科茲是誰？為什麼要把他綁起來？

column1: Thor's mighty hammer will do all the striking I need.
column2: 索爾的雷神之鎚會替我完成所有敲擊。
